title: AI Video Pipeline: one prompt to a YouTube script
summary: Research a topic, fact-check every claim, write the script in your voice, and chunk it for voice cloning. Later stages render avatar video with motion graphics and QC it visually.
how_to_use: Say "make a video about X" or "write a video script about X".
requires: Stage 1 needs no keys. Voice and avatar stages need your own ElevenLabs/HeyGen accounts. The voice profile is Jesse's, so swap in your own.
